mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS rate is 4.33% as of 2025-07-01, but trending upward
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market overheating, which triggers inflationary wage pressures and forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:UNRATE is 4.3% as of 2025-07-01, but declining
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1,400,000 units signals strong household demand and rising confidence, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST rose to 1379.0 in June 2025, approaching 1400 threshold
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of triggered instances, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0, following a prior rise, signals a manufacturing contraction and weakening economic momentum, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:INDPRO fell to 101.894 in July 2025, down from 103.9867 in June
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the mean return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption (GDPC1) and residential investment (HOUST) signals broad-based demand strength, which increases corporate earnings visibility and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:GDPC1 rose to 23770.976 billion in Q2 2025, HOUST increased to 1379.0 in June 2025
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction regression).

mechanism_narrative: A divergence between rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) and stagnant or declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals stagflationary pressures, prompting the Fed to maintain high rates despite weak supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:CPIAUCSL is 322.17, INDPRO is 101.894 as of July 2025
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 322.0 and INDPRO < 102.0, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-significant negative coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:PAYEMS fell to 158542 in July 2025, UNRATE rose to 4.3%
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 159000 and UNRATE > 4.2%, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (GDPC1) combined with rising residential investment (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and housing demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:GDPC1 and HOUST both show upward trends in Q2 2025
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).
